capabilities: Render vocabulary words as flashcard previews
Display vocabulary words as a list table
Define words and meanings in YAML block format
Track correct-answer statistics in a data.json file
Reset statistics by deleting the data file
extras: README includes manual installation steps (copying main.js, styles.css, manifest.json) rather than pointing to a community plugin store.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display vocabulary words and their meanings as study flashcards directly inside notes.
summary: Vocabulary flashcard plugin that renders YAML blocks in notes as randomly picked word cards or as a full word list.
